the following questions: How can we use containers to deliver a multi tenant, highly available, scalable, stateful cloud service by reusing a legacy codebase?
the following question: How can a legacy Web application that uses a stateless, multi-tier architecture be transformed into a multi-tenant service that provides a stateful, multi-tier architecture?
